mechanism: Both agents have cardiovascular effects; amlodipine causes vasodilation and timolol (even ophthalmic formulation) can cause systemic beta-blockade, potentially leading to additive hypotensive and negative inotropic effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate regularly; ophthalmic timolol has minimal systemic absorption but caution is warranted in patients on amlodipine, particularly those with baseline hypotension or cardiac conduction abnormalities.
